title: Kagamine Len — Arms Laden With Snacks〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good to see the “me”s in those SEKAI working hard as usual!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also... Oh!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Talk about great timing, you two!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Len, are you all done visiting those SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Today, I went over to see how idol me and theater me were doing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I made a pretty fun discovery!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A fun discovery?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: See, both mes were talking to their KAITOs, and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder if things would feel more exciting during the chorus if we turn down these lights a little?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're right... Thank you, Len.
I'll try adjusting it so that there's more contrast before and after the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, I want to make things feel a little more special since we're performing a duet...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we add a bit of banter during the intro?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right, since the intro is pretty long.
Yeah, that is a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO! About the final showdown between the hero and the dinosaurs. Wouldn't it be cool if fire shot out of his sword?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Fire, huh... With some creative lighting and sound effects, I think we can make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? Then, what if the dinosaurs breathe fire too?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?! The dinosaurs too?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet everyone's gonna be as stunned as you are right now, KAITO! And then, when the flames cross, there can be a huuuge explosion—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
I'd like to jot this down, so go more slowly for me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So basically, what I noticed is that they each approached the conversation totally differently.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The idol versions of you and KAITO shared their opinions on how to make their show more compelling...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While the show version of you came up with a lot of ideas he wanted to try, and I thought of ways to make them into reality.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly! So, that made me wonder...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think would happen if those two mes changed places?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, if they changed places?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That would probably startle both versions of me, but I'm sure it wouldn't take very long for them to all become friends.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Especially since they're both so good at looking after others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As for each Len, they'd probably be very interested in learning more about idols and performing in shows, and ask each KAITO to teach them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! I do get that feeling!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! What about the other mes, then? Like DJ me, or that shy me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure DJ Len would do well in any of the SEKAI, but the band SEKAI might be the best fit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. Band me may have some trouble getting used to that version of Len since he likes to get up close and personal, but music could help bridge that divide.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I can totally see that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Speaking of band KAITO, couldn't he also help shy Len get settled in?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, they probably think on the same wavelength!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Conversely, that Len would probably find DJ me a bit intimidating.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you sure? DJ KAITO knows how to meet people where they're at, so they might get along surprisingly well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! He might be interested in what it's like to be a DJ, and that's where their friendship could begin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
That scenario does seem plausible.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Len, which SEKAI would you yourself like to change places into?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All of them!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, instead of switching places, I wanna become friends with the me from every SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're all me, so I'm sure we'd get along great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And there's so much that I wanna talk to them about since I've been watching over all of them for forever.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Come to think of it...
I'd also like to talk to my counterparts from the other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me as well. We were given an opportunity a while ago, but it was so short.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah... Right, back then.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder if someday, we'll get to all be together at once, and talk for as long as we want?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That would be very lively.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Maybe that's a little too out there to come true...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But I do hope that we all get to talk to each other someday!)
